verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a one-command install flow — `/plugins` browser or `$skill-installer <name>` — and state that after installing a plugin you should 'start a new session before using its bundled skills or tools,' directly matching the story's install-then-next-session pattern. Additional CLI support (`codex plugin marketplace add`) reinforces multiple documented one-liner paths. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that installed skills actually activate reliably in the next session (only vendor docs, no community verification of this specific flow).
